<!doctype html>
<html lang="es">
<head>
  <meta charset="utf-8" />
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1" />
  <title>Parva MVP</title>
  <link rel="icon" type="image/png" href="data:image/png;base64," />
  <!-- Brand fonts via CDN (no build, no local files): Switzer (Fontshare) + Instrument Serif (Google) -->
  <link rel="preconnect" href="https://api.fontshare.com" crossorigin />
  <link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com" />
  <link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin />
  <link rel="stylesheet" href="https://api.fontshare.com/v2/css?f[]=switzer@400,500,600,700&display=swap" />
  <link rel="stylesheet" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Instrument+Serif:ital@0;1&display=swap" />
  <link rel="stylesheet" href="/styles.css" />
</head>
<body>
  <header class="topbar">
    <div class="brand"><img class="logo" src="data:image/png;base64," alt="Parva" /><small>MVP</small></div>
    <div class="controls">
      <label class="field">Productor
        <select id="selProductor"></select>
        <span id="variante" class="badge"></span>
      </label>
      <button id="btnExport" class="btn-ghost" title="Descargar la planilla en CSV">Exportar CSV <svg class="btn-ico" viewBox="0 0 256 256" fill="currentColor" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M228,144v64a12,12,0,0,1-12,12H40a12,12,0,0,1-12-12V144a12,12,0,0,1,24,0v52H204V144a12,12,0,0,1,24,0Zm-108.49,8.49a12,12,0,0,0,16.98,0l40-40a12,12,0,0,0-16.98-16.98L140,115V40a12,12,0,0,0-24,0v75L99.51,95.51a12,12,0,0,0-16.98,16.98Z"/></svg></button>
    </div>
  </header>

  <main class="layout">
    <div id="kpis" class="kpis"></div>
    <div id="panels"></div>
  </main>

  <script src="/app.js" type="module"></script>
  <script>
  // Dropdown component (design system). Progressive enhancement: the native
  // <select> elements stay in the DOM as the source of truth for app.js; this
  // only draws a styled UI on top and syncs the native value + change event.
  (function () {
    function enhance(select, opts) {
      opts = opts || {};
      if (!select || select.dataset.enhanced) return;
      select.dataset.enhanced = '1';
      var dd = document.createElement('div');
      dd.className = 'dropdown' + (opts.className ? ' ' + opts.className : '');
      var trigger = document.createElement('button');
      trigger.type = 'button';
      trigger.className = 'dd-trigger';
      trigger.setAttribute('aria-haspopup', 'listbox');
      trigger.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
      var label = document.createElement('span');
      label.className = 'dd-label';
      trigger.appendChild(label);
      if (opts.slot) trigger.appendChild(opts.slot);
      var chevron = document.createElement('span');
      chevron.className = 'dd-chevron';
      chevron.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');
      chevron.innerHTML = '<svg viewBox="0 0 256 256" fill="currentColor"><path d="M216.49,104.49l-80,80a12,12,0,0,1-16.98,0l-80-80a12,12,0,0,1,16.98-16.98L128,159l71.51-71.49a12,12,0,0,1,16.98,16.98Z"/></svg>';
      trigger.appendChild(chevron);
      var menu = document.createElement('div');
      menu.className = 'dd-menu';
      menu.setAttribute('role', 'listbox');
      menu.hidden = true;

      select.parentNode.insertBefore(dd, select);
      dd.appendChild(trigger);
      dd.appendChild(menu);
      dd.appendChild(select); // keep the native select, just move it inside (hidden)

      function syncLabel() {
        var opt = select.options[select.selectedIndex];
        label.textContent = opt ? opt.textContent : '';
      }
      function buildMenu() {
        menu.innerHTML = '';
        Array.prototype.forEach.call(select.options, function (opt, i) {
          var item = document.createElement('button');
          item.type = 'button';
          item.className = 'dd-option';
          item.setAttribute('role', 'option');
          item.setAttribute('aria-selected', i === select.selectedIndex ? 'true' : 'false');
          var name = document.createElement('span');
          name.className = 'dd-opt-name';
          name.textContent = opt.textContent;
          item.appendChild(name);
          var meta = opts.optionMeta ? opts.optionMeta(opt) : null;
          if (meta) {
            var chip = document.createElement('span');
            chip.className = 'dd-opt-chip';
            chip.textContent = meta;
            item.appendChild(chip);
          }
          item.addEventListener('click', function () {
            if (select.value !== opt.value) {
              select.value = opt.value;
              select.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', { bubbles: true }));
            }
            close();
          });
          menu.appendChild(item);
        });
      }
      function place() {
        var r = trigger.getBoundingClientRect();
        menu.style.top = (r.bottom + 4) + 'px';
        menu.style.minWidth = r.width + 'px';
        menu.style.left = '0px';
        var mw = menu.offsetWidth;
        var left = r.left;
        if (left + mw > window.innerWidth - 8) left = Math.max(8, window.innerWidth - mw - 8);
        menu.style.left = left + 'px';
      }
      function open() { buildMenu(); menu.hidden = false; dd.classList.add('open'); trigger.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'true'); place(); }
      function close() { menu.hidden = true; dd.classList.remove('open'); trigger.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false'); }
      trigger.addEventListener('click', function (e) { e.preventDefault(); if (menu.hidden) open(); else close(); });
      document.addEventListener('click', function (e) { if (!dd.contains(e.target) && !menu.contains(e.target)) close(); });
      document.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) { if (e.key === 'Escape') close(); });
      window.addEventListener('scroll', function () { if (!menu.hidden) close(); }, true);
      window.addEventListener('resize', function () { if (!menu.hidden) close(); });
      select.addEventListener('change', syncLabel);
      new MutationObserver(function () { syncLabel(); if (!menu.hidden) buildMenu(); })
        .observe(select, { childList: true });
      syncLabel();
    }

    // Margin cards: put the lote name + crop tag on one header row.
    function decorateMargenes(panels) {
      Array.prototype.forEach.call(panels.querySelectorAll('.card'), function (card) {
        if (card.querySelector('.card-head')) return;
        var lote = card.querySelector('.lote');
        if (!lote) return;
        var uso = card.querySelector('.uso');
        var head = document.createElement('div');
        head.className = 'card-head';
        lote.parentNode.insertBefore(head, lote);
        head.appendChild(lote);
        if (uso) { if (uso.textContent.trim()) head.appendChild(uso); else uso.remove(); }
      });
    }

    function boot() {
      var panels = document.getElementById('panels');
      if (panels) {
        new MutationObserver(function () { decorateMargenes(panels); }).observe(panels, { childList: true });
        decorateMargenes(panels);
      }
      var sp = document.getElementById('selProductor');
      var variante = document.getElementById('variante');
      fetch('/api/productores').then(function (r) { return r.json(); }).then(function (list) {
        var byId = {};
        list.forEach(function (p) { byId[String(p.id)] = p.tipo_campo; });
        enhance(sp, { slot: variante, className: 'dropdown-productor', optionMeta: function (opt) { return byId[opt.value] || null; } });
      }).catch(function () {
        enhance(sp, { slot: variante, className: 'dropdown-productor' });
      });
    }
    if (document.readyState === 'loading') document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', boot);
    else boot();
  })();
  </script>
</body>
</html>

### GET /styles.css
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
Content-Type: text/css; charset=utf-8

/* =========================================================================
   Parva: Design tokens
   PR1: color tokens only. Every value below equals the previous hardcoded
   one, so this change is visually a no-op. Structure mirrors parva-landing
   (primitives -> semantic roles) so both apps share one vocabulary.
   Typography, spacing, radius, shadow and motion tokens come in later PRs.
   ========================================================================= */
:root {
  /* =========================================================================
     Tier 1: color SCALES (full landing ramps; shared vocabulary with
     parva-landing). Not every step is used by a component today; they exist
     as the palette to design against. Step number = lightness (50 light .. 900 dark).
     ========================================================================= */
  /* Blue / Celeste: the ACTION color (reserve for buttons, focus, links) */
  --clr-blue-50:  #F1F8FD;  --clr-blue-100: #DBECFA;  --clr-blue-200: #B1DAFB;
  --clr-blue-300: #7FC2F9;  --clr-blue-400: #46A7F6;  --clr-blue-500: #0B8BF4;
  --clr-blue-600: #096FC3;  --clr-blue-700: #075392;  --clr-blue-800: #053861;  --clr-blue-900: #072136;
  /* Green: brand / surfaces / nature */
  --clr-green-50:  #F6F9F5;  --clr-green-100: #E7F0E5;  --clr-green-200: #CEE3CA;
  --clr-green-300: #AACEA1;  --clr-green-400: #8BBC80;  --clr-green-500: #67A758;
  --clr-green-600: #528646;  --clr-green-700: #3E6435;  --clr-green-800: #294323;
  --clr-green-900: #1A2717;  --clr-green-950: #09221F;  --clr-green-975: #051310;
  /* Clay / Terracotta: warm accent */
  --clr-clay-50:  #FAF5F5;  --clr-clay-100: #F1E6E4;  --clr-clay-200: #E6CAC7;
  --clr-clay-300: #D3A39C;  --clr-clay-400: #C38279;  --clr-clay-500: #B05B4F;
  --clr-clay-600: #8D493F;  --clr-clay-700: #6A362F;  --clr-clay-800: #47241F;  --clr-clay-900: #291715;
  /* Sand / Neutral: background, text, borders */
  --clr-sand-25:  #FCFCF9;  --clr-sand-50:  #FAFAF2;  --clr-sand-100: #F2F2E8;  --clr-sand-200: #E7E7DA;
  --clr-sand-300: #D4D3C2;  --clr-sand-400: #B6B5A6;  --clr-sand-500: #8C8B7F;
  --clr-sand-muted: #5C6B62;  --clr-ink: #0B201C;  --clr-cream: #F4F4E6;  --clr-cream-muted: #A9B8AE;
  --clr-white: #FFFFFF;
  /* Gray / Neutral (app canvas: cooler than sand, near-black text) */
  --clr-gray-50:  #FAFAFA;  --clr-gray-100: #F2F3F4;  --clr-gray-200: #E7E8EA;
  --clr-gray-300: #D6D8DB;  --clr-gray-400: #AEB2B7;  --clr-gray-500: #71767C;
  --clr-gray-600: #565B61;  --clr-gray-700: #3E4247;  --clr-gray-800: #26292D;  --clr-gray-900: #1A1A1A;
  /* State ramps (text + bg pairs) */
  --clr-info-text:    #096FC3;  --clr-info-bg:    #E6F1FB;
  --clr-success-text: #3E6435;  --clr-success-bg: #E7F0E5;
  --clr-warning-text: #8A5A00;  --clr-warning-bg: #FBF0D8;
  --clr-danger-text:  #B3261E;  --clr-danger-bg:  #FBEAE8;

  /* WhatsApp: fixed literals, NOT part of the brand scale. They mark the "bot"
     origin tag in the planilla, i.e. the rows that came in through WhatsApp. */
  --wa-header:   #128c4a;
  --wa-outgoing: #d8fdd2;

  /* =========================================================================
     Tier 2: semantic roles (what components reference). Re-skinning = point
     these at different scale steps.
     ========================================================================= */
  --background:        var(--clr-sand-25);    /* near-white, faint warmth */
  --foreground:        var(--clr-gray-900);   /* near-black text */
  --muted-foreground:  var(--clr-gray-500);   /* neutral gray */
  --surface:           var(--clr-white);
  --surface-2:         var(--clr-sand-100);   /* panel header */
  --border:            var(--clr-sand-300);
  --border-soft:       var(--clr-sand-100);
  --primary:           var(--clr-green-600);  /* brand green */
  --primary-strong:    var(--clr-green-700);  /* emphasis text */
  --primary-bg:        var(--clr-green-100);
  --on-primary:        var(--clr-white);
  /* action = celeste (reserve for interactive: focus, links, action buttons/chips) */
  --action:            var(--clr-blue-300);
  --action-hover:      var(--clr-blue-400);
  --action-active:     var(--clr-blue-500);
  --action-bg:         var(--clr-blue-50);
  --action-text:       var(--clr-blue-700);
  --on-action:         var(--clr-ink);        /* ink on celeste, never white */
  --link:              var(--clr-blue-600);
  --ring:              var(--clr-blue-300);   /* celeste focus */
  /* state / category (mapped onto the brand scales) */
  --danger:            var(--clr-danger-text);
  --danger-bg:         var(--clr-danger-bg);
  --warning:           var(--clr-warning-text);
  --warning-bg:        var(--clr-warning-bg);
  --info:              var(--clr-info-text);
  --info-bg:           var(--clr-info-bg);
  --labor:             var(--clr-clay-600);   /* labor tag -> terracotta accent */
  --labor-bg:          var(--clr-clay-100);

  /* --- Typography --- */
  --font-sans:  "Switzer", system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif;
  --font-serif: "Instrument Serif", Georgia, "Times New Roman", serif;   /* display / accent only */

  --text-2xs:  10px;
  --text-xs:   11px;
  --text-xs2:  11.5px;   /* ponytail: off-grid, snap to the scale in move 2 */
  --text-sm:   12px;
  --text-md:   13px;
  --text-md2:  13.5px;   /* ponytail: off-grid, snap to the scale in move 2 */
  --text-base: 14px;
  --text-lg:   15px;
  --text-xl:   16px;
  --text-2xl:  20px;
  --text-3xl:  22px;
  --text-4xl:  24px;

  --weight-normal:   400;
  --weight-medium:   500;
  --weight-semibold: 600;
  --weight-bold:     700;

  --leading-base: 1.45;

  --tracking-tight: -.3px;
  --tracking-wide:  .4px;
  --tracking-wider: .5px;

  /* --- Spacing (4px grid, landing-aligned) --- */
  --space-2xs: 4px;
  --space-xs:  8px;
  --space-sm:  12px;
  --space-md:  16px;
  --space-lg:  20px;
  --space-xl:  24px;
  --space-2xl: 32px;

  /* --- Radius (landing scale) --- */
  --radius-xs:    4px;
  --radius-sm:    6px;    /* small inline (alerta) */
  --radius-md:    10px;   /* controls: selects, ghost button */
  --radius-lg:    16px;   /* cards, kpi, panel */
  --radius-xl:    24px;
  --radius-2xl:   32px;
  --radius:       var(--radius-md);   /* default radius, matches parva-landing */
  --radius-pill:  9999px; /* fully-round pills: badges, tags */
  --radius-round: 50%;    /* circular controls */

  /* --- Borders --- */
  --border-width: 1px;

  /* --- Shadows --- */
  --shadow-xs: 0 1px 1px rgba(0, 0, 0, .08);
  --shadow-sm: 0 1px 3px rgba(0, 0, 0, .08), 0 1px 2px rgba(0, 0, 0, .04);
}

* { box-sizing: border-box; }

body {
  margin: 0;
  font-family: var(--font-sans);
  background: var(--background);
  color: var(--foreground);
  line-height: var(--leading-base);
}

/* ---- Topbar ---- */
.topbar {
  display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between;
  padding: var(--space-md) var(--space-xl); background: var(--surface); border-bottom: var(--border-width) solid var(--border);
  position: sticky; top: 0; z-index: 10;
}
.brand { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: var(--space-xs); }
.logo { height: 28px; width: auto; display: block; }
.brand small { font-family: var(--font-sans); font-size: var(--text-xs); font-weight: var(--weight-medium); color: var(--clr-gray-700); background: var(--clr-gray-100); border: var(--border-width) solid var(--clr-gray-200); padding: var(--space-2xs) var(--space-xs); border-radius: var(--radius-pill); letter-spacing: var(--tracking-wider); }
.controls { display: flex; align-items: flex-end; gap: var(--space-md); }
.field { font-size: var(--text-xs); color: var(--muted-foreground); display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: var(--space-2xs); font-weight: var(--weight-medium); line-height: 1.3; }
/* Native selects: kept for app.js, hidden: the custom dropdown drives them */
.field select { position: absolute; width: 1px; height: 1px; opacity: 0; pointer-events: none; margin: 0; }

/* Dropdown (design-system component, fixed width) */
.dropdown { position: relative; }
.dd-trigger {
  display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: var(--space-2xs);
  width: 280px; height: 40px; padding: 0 var(--space-sm);
  background: var(--surface); border: var(--border-width) solid var(--border); border-radius: var(--radius-md);
  color: var(--foreground); font-family: inherit; font-size: var(--text-md); font-weight: var(--weight-normal);
  text-align: left; cursor: pointer;
}
.dd-trigger:hover { border-color: var(--clr-sand-400); }
.dropdown.open .dd-trigger, .dd-trigger:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: var(--ring); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px var(--action-bg); }
.dd-label { min-width: 0; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; }
.dd-trigger .badge { flex: none; font-size: var(--text-2xs); padding: 2px var(--space-2xs); letter-spacing: var(--tracking-wide); }
.dd-chevron { flex: none; margin-left: auto; width: 16px; height: 16px; color: var(--muted-foreground); transition: transform 150ms ease; }
.dd-chevron svg { width: 100%; height: 100%; display: block; }
.dropdown.open .dd-chevron { transform: rotate(180deg); }
.dd-menu {
  position: fixed; z-index: 50;
  background: var(--surface); border: var(--border-width) solid var(--border); border-radius: var(--radius-md);
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm); padding: var(--space-2xs); display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 2px;
}
.dd-menu[hidden] { display: none; }
.dd-option {
  display: flex; align-items: center; gap: var(--space-xs); width: 100%; text-align: left; white-space: nowrap;
  padding: var(--space-xs) var(--space-sm); border: none; background: none; border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
  font-family: inherit; font-size: var(--text-md); font-weight: var(--weight-medium); color: var(--foreground); cursor: pointer;
}
.dd-opt-name { flex: 1; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; }
.dd-opt-chip { flex: none; font-size: var(--text-2xs); font-weight: var(--weight-medium); text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: var(--tracking-wide); color: var(--clr-gray-600); background: var(--surface-2); border: var(--border-width) solid var(--border); padding: 2px var(--space-2xs); border-radius: var(--radius-pill); }
.dd-option:hover { background: var(--surface-2); }
.dd-option[aria-selected="true"] { background: var(--primary-bg); }

.badge { font-size: var(--text-xs); font-weight: var(--weight-medium); text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: var(--tracking-wide); color: var(--clr-gray-600); background: var(--surface-2); border: var(--border-width) solid var(--border); padding: var(--space-2xs) var(--space-sm); border-radius: var(--radius-pill); }
.btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: var(--space-2xs); height: 40px; padding: 0 var(--space-md); background: var(--surface); border: var(--border-width) solid var(--border); color: var(--foreground); border-radius: var(--radius-md); cursor: pointer; font-family: inherit; font-size: var(--text-md); font-weight: var(--weight-normal); }
.btn-ghost:hover { background: var(--action-bg); border-color: var(--action); }
.btn-ico { flex: none; width: 16px; height: 16px; color: var(--muted-foreground); }

/* ---- Layout ---- */
.layout { padding: var(--space-xl); max-width: 1300px; margin: 0 auto; }

/* ---- KPIs ---- */
.kpis { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(150px, 1fr)); gap: var(--space-md); margin-bottom: var(--space-lg); }
.kpi { display: flex; flex-direction: column-reverse; gap: var(--space-xs); background: var(--surface); border: var(--border-width) solid var(--border); border-radius: var(--radius-lg); padding: var(--space-md); }
.kpi .v { font-size: var(--text-4xl); font-weight: var(--weight-medium); color: var(--primary-strong); }
.kpi .l { font-size: var(--text-xs); color: var(--muted-foreground); text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: var(--tracking-wide); font-weight: var(--weight-semibold); }

/* ---- Panels ---- */
.panel { background: var(--surface); border: var(--border-width) solid var(--border); border-radius: var(--radius-lg); margin-bottom: var(--space-lg); overflow: hidden; }
.panel h2 { font-size: var(--text-md); font-weight: var(--weight-medium); margin: 0; padding: var(--space-sm) var(--space-md); border-bottom: var(--border-width) solid var(--clr-sand-200); background: var(--surface-2); }
.panel-body { padding: var(--space-md) var(--space-lg); }

table { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; font-size: var(--text-md); }
th { text-align: left; color: var(--muted-foreground); font-weight: var(--weight-semibold); font-size: var(--text-xs); text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: var(--tracking-wide); padding: var(--space-xs) var(--space-md); background: var(--clr-sand-50); border-bottom: var(--border-width) solid var(--clr-sand-200); }
td { padding: var(--space-sm) var(--space-md); border-bottom: var(--border-width) solid var(--border-soft); }
tr:last-child td { border-bottom: none; }
.tag { font-size: var(--text-xs); font-weight: var(--weight-medium); text-transform: capitalize; padding: var(--space-2xs) var(--space-xs); border-radius: var(--radius-pill); background: var(--primary-bg); color: var(--primary-strong); }
.tag.venta { background: var(--primary-bg); color: var(--primary-strong); }
.tag.insumo { background: var(--info-bg); color: var(--info); }
.tag.gasto { background: var(--warning-bg); color: var(--warning); }
.tag.labor { background: var(--clr-gray-100); color: var(--clr-gray-600); }
.tag.bot { background: var(--wa-outgoing); color: var(--wa-header); }
.num { font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; text-align: right; }

/* ---- Lotes / márgenes ---- */
.grid-cards { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(220px, 1fr)); gap: var(--space-md); }
.card { display: flex; flex-direction: column; border: var(--border-width) solid var(--border); border-radius: var(--radius-lg); padding: var(--space-md); }
.card-head { display: flex; align-items: center; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: var(--space-xs); }
.card .lote { font-size: var(--text-base); font-weight: var(--weight-medium); }
.card .uso { font-size: var(--text-2xs); font-weight: var(--weight-medium); text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: var(--tracking-wide); color: var(--clr-gray-600); background: var(--surface-2); border: var(--border-width) solid var(--border); padding: 2px var(--space-2xs); border-radius: var(--radius-pill); }
.card .uso:empty { display: none; }
.card .margen { font-size: var(--text-2xl); font-weight: var(--weight-medium); color: var(--primary-strong); margin-top: var(--space-sm); }
.card .desglose { font-size: var(--text-xs); color: var(--muted-foreground); text-transform: capitalize; margin-top: auto; padding-top: var(--space-sm); }
.card.no-confiable .margen { color: var(--muted-foreground); font-size: var(--text-base); margin-bottom: var(--space-md); }
.alerta { font-size: var(--text-xs2); background: var(--warning-bg); color: var(--warning); text-transform: capitalize; padding: var(--space-xs) var(--space-sm); border-radius: var(--radius-sm); margin-top: auto; font-weight: var(--weight-normal); }

.empty { color: var(--muted-foreground); font-size: var(--text-md); padding: var(--space-xs) 0; }

### GET /app.js
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
Content-Type: text/javascript; charset=utf-8

// Parva — front vanilla (sin build). Consume la API del backend.
const $ = (id) => document.getElementById(id);
const esc = (s) => String(s ?? '').replace(/[&<>"]/g, (c) => ({ '&': '&amp;', '<': '&lt;', '>': '&gt;', '"': '&quot;' }[c]));
const fmtMoney = (n) => (n == null ? '—' : new Intl.NumberFormat('es-AR', { style: 'currency', currency: 'ARS', maximumFractionDigits: 0 }).format(n));
const api = (url, opts) => fetch(url, opts).then((r) => r.json());

let current = null;         // { productor, ... } estado actual
let productorActivo = null; // id elegido en el selector
let ultimoEstado = '';      // serializado del último estado pintado
let secuenciaRefresco = 0;
let ultimoRefrescoAplicado = 0;

// Los datos entran por WhatsApp desde el celular del productor, no desde esta
// página: sin un refresco propio el dashboard queda congelado hasta un F5.
const REFRESH_MS = 5000;
let timerRefresco = null;

// ---- Carga inicial ----
async function init() {
  const productores = await api('/api/productores');
  $('selProductor').innerHTML = productores
    .map((p) => `<option value="${p.id}">${esc(p.nombre)}</option>`).join('');
  $('selProductor').onchange = () => selectProductor(Number($('selProductor').value));
  $('btnExport').onclick = () => window.open(`/api/export?productorId=${current.productor.id}&sheet=movimientos`, '_blank');
  await selectProductor(productores[0].id);
  autoRefresco();
}

async function selectProductor(pid) {
  productorActivo = pid;
  // Invalida las peticiones de la selección anterior, incluso si se vuelve al
  // mismo productor antes de que terminen.
  ultimoRefrescoAplicado = ++secuenciaRefresco;
  await refrescar();
}

/**
 * Pinta el estado sólo si cambió.
 *
 * Con la pestaña abierta esto corre cada 5 s, y un innerHTML por tick le
 * voltearía el scroll y la selección de texto a alguien que está leyendo la
 * planilla. El id del productor viaja adentro del estado, así que cambiar de
 * productor siempre difiere y repinta.
 */
function aplicarEstado(state) {
  // Un refresco del productor anterior puede seguir en vuelo cuando se cambia
  // de productor y contestar DESPUÉS: sin este guard la página vuelve sola al
  // productor viejo y se queda ahí, porque los próximos ticks lo siguen a él.
  if (state?.productor?.id !== productorActivo) return;

  // Sólo estas colecciones alimentan la vista. Una consulta del bot cambia
  // `mensajes` sin cambiar la planilla y debe conservar el DOM y su selección.
  const { productor, movimientos, hacienda, lotes, sanidad, margenes } = state;
  const snapshot = JSON.stringify({ productor, movimientos, hacienda, lotes, sanidad, margenes });
  current = state;
  if (snapshot === ultimoEstado) return;
  ultimoEstado = snapshot;
  renderDashboard();
}

async function refrescar() {
  if (productorActivo == null) return;
  const solicitud = ++secuenciaRefresco;
  try {
    const state = await api(`/api/state?productorId=${productorActivo}`);
    // Una petición lenta puede aplicarse mientras no haya una respuesta más
    // reciente: así el dashboard también avanza cuando la red tarda más de 5 s.
    if (solicitud < ultimoRefrescoAplicado) return;
    aplicarEstado(state);
    ultimoRefrescoAplicado = solicitud;
  } catch {
    // Una falla puntual (server reiniciando, red) no rompe nada: el próximo
    // tick reintenta y mientras tanto queda a la vista lo último bueno.
  }
}

// Sólo consulta con la pestaña visible: una pestaña de fondo no le sirve a
// nadie y son 12 requests por minuto. Al volver refresca de una, para no
// quedarse mirando datos viejos hasta que caiga el tick.
function autoRefresco() {
  const arrancar = () => { timerRefresco ??= setInterval(refrescar, REFRESH_MS); };
  const parar = () => { clearInterval(timerRefresco); timerRefresco = null; };
  document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', () => {
    if (document.hidden) return parar();
    refrescar();
    arrancar();
  });
  if (!document.hidden) arrancar();
}

// ---- Render dashboard ----
function renderDashboard() {
  const { productor: p, movimientos, hacienda, lotes } = current;
  $('variante').textContent = p.tipo_campo;

  const gasto = movimientos.filter((m) => ['insumo', 'labor', 'gasto'].includes(m.tipo)).reduce((a, m) => a + (m.monto || 0), 0);
  const venta = movimientos.filter((m) => m.tipo === 'venta').reduce((a, m) => a + (m.monto || 0), 0);
  const cabezas = hacienda.reduce((a, h) => a + h.cantidad, 0);
  const ha = lotes.reduce((a, l) => a + (l.hectareas || 0), 0);

  // La variante define qué paneles se muestran por default, pero si hay datos de
  // la otra actividad hay que mostrarlos igual. El bot no mira tipo_campo: un
  // productor agrícola que carga hacienda por WhatsApp recibía el ✅ y no veía
  // ningún cambio en la página (el dato estaba guardado, el panel no se dibujaba).
  const verAgro = p.tipo_campo !== 'ganadero' || lotes.length > 0;
  const verHacienda = p.tipo_campo !== 'agricola' || hacienda.length > 0 || current.sanidad.length > 0;

  const kpis = [['Movimientos', movimientos.length], ['Gastos', fmtMoney(gasto)], ['Ventas', fmtMoney(venta)]];
  if (verAgro) kpis.push(['Hectáreas', `${ha} ha`]);
  if (verHacienda) kpis.push(['Hacienda', `${cabezas} cabezas`]);
  $('kpis').innerHTML = kpis.map(([l, v]) => `<div class="kpi"><div class="v">${esc(v)}</div><div class="l">${l}</div></div>`).join('');

  let html = panelPlanilla();
  if (verAgro) html += panelMargenes();
  if (verHacienda) html += panelHacienda() + panelSanidad();
  $('panels').innerHTML = html;
}

function panelPlanilla() {
  const rows = current.movimientos.map((m) => `
    <tr>
      <td>${esc(m.fecha)}</td>
      <td><span class="tag ${esc(m.tipo)}">${esc(m.tipo)}</span></td>
      <td>${esc(m.lote_nombre ?? '—')}</td>
      <td>${esc(m.producto ?? '')} ${m.cantidad != null ? esc(m.cantidad) + ' ' + esc(m.unidad ?? '') : ''}</td>
      <td class="num">${m.monto != null ? fmtMoney(m.monto) : '—'}</td>
      <td><span class="tag ${m.origen === 'bot' ? 'bot' : ''}">${esc(m.origen)}</span></td>
    </tr>`).join('');
  return `<div class="panel"><h2>Planilla · gestión diaria</h2><div class="panel-body" style="padding:0">
    <table><thead><tr><th>Fecha</th><th>Tipo</th><th>Lote</th><th>Detalle</th><th class="num">Monto</th><th>Origen</th></tr></thead>
    <tbody>${rows || '<tr><td colspan="6" class="empty">Sin movimientos.</td></tr>'}</tbody></table></div></div>`;
}

function panelMargenes() {
  const cards = current.margenes.map((m) => {
    if (!m.confiable) {
      return `<div class="card no-confiable"><div class="lote">${esc(m.loteNombre)}</div><div class="uso">${esc(m.uso ?? '')}</div>
        <div class="margen">Margen no disponible</div>
        <div class="alerta">⚠ ${esc(m.razon)} · costos ${fmtMoney(m.costos)}</div></div>`;
    }
    return `<div class="card"><div class="lote">${esc(m.loteNombre)}</div><div class="uso">${esc(m.uso ?? '')}</div>
      <div class="margen">${fmtMoney(m.margen)}</div>
      <div class="desglose">ventas ${fmtMoney(m.ventas)} − costos ${fmtMoney(m.costos)}</div></div>`;
  }).join('');
  return `<div class="panel"><h2>Lotes y márgenes</h2><div class="panel-body"><div class="grid-cards">${cards || '<div class="empty">Sin lotes.</div>'}</div></div></div>`;
}

function panelHacienda() {
  const total = current.hacienda.reduce((a, h) => a + h.cantidad, 0);
  const rows = current.hacienda.map((h) => `<tr><td>${esc(h.categoria)}</td><td class="num">${esc(h.cantidad)}</td></tr>`).join('');
  return `<div class="panel"><h2>Hacienda · stock actual (${total} cabezas)</h2><div class="panel-body" style="padding:0">
    <table><thead><tr><th>Categoría</th><th class="num">Cantidad</th></tr></thead><tbody>${rows || '<tr><td colspan="2" class="empty">Sin hacienda.</td></tr>'}</tbody></table></div></div>`;
}

function panelSanidad() {
  const rows = current.sanidad.map((s) => `<tr><td>${esc(s.fecha)}</td><td>${esc(s.producto ?? '')}</td><td>${esc(s.categoria ?? '')}</td><td class="num">${esc(s.cantidad ?? '')}</td></tr>`).join('');
  return `<div class="panel"><h2>Sanidad</h2><div class="panel-body" style="padding:0">
    <table><thead><tr><th>Fecha</th><th>Producto</th><th>Categoría</th><th class="num">Cantidad</th></tr></thead><tbody>${rows || '<tr><td colspan="4" class="empty">Sin registros.</td></tr>'}</tbody></table></div></div>`;
}

init();
